mods.name: Log Filter
mods.description:
A lightweight log filtering mod that intercepts and drops log lines by configurable rules (regex / exact match / logger name / log level / whitelist) before they reach the console and log files. Features an async output pipeline (Log4j2 AsyncAppender) and config hot-reload.
轻量级日志过滤模组：按可配置规则（正则/完全匹配/Logger名称/日志等级/白名单）在日志到达控制台和文件之前拦截丢弃。内置异步输出管线（Log4j2 AsyncAppender）与配置热重载。

releases.notes:
## Log Filter 1.1.0 for Minecraft 1.20.1 (Forge 47+)

### Added
- **Async output pipeline**: all root-logger appenders are wrapped into a Log4j2 `AsyncAppender` (enabled by default) — console/file I/O runs on a background thread, the logging thread only pays the enqueue cost. Queue size, overflow policy and shutdown timeout are fully configurable.

### Fixed
- A single invalid regex (e.g. unbalanced parentheses) used to crash config loading; it is now skipped safely — a WARN goes to the log and an in-game chat warning appears when you enter a world. All other rules keep working.

### Existing features (baseline for future changelogs)
Lightweight log filtering: intercepts and drops log lines by configurable rules before they reach the console or log file — less spam, less disk usage.
- Regex filtering (partial match), exact match, logger-name & log-level filtering
- Whitelist exclusion to protect critical logs
- Dedup cache for repeated log events
- Config hot-reload — edit & save, no restart needed
- Bilingual config comments documenting every regex/TOML escaping pitfall

---

### 新增
- **异步输出管线**：root logger 全部 Appender 包装进 Log4j2 `AsyncAppender`（默认开启），打日志线程只付入队成本；队列容量、满载策略、关停超时全部可配置。

### 修复
- 单条非法正则（如括号不闭合）曾导致配置加载崩溃；现在安全跳过——日志 WARN + 进入世界时聊天框黄字警告，其余规则照常生效。

### 既有功能（作为以后更新日志的基准）
轻量级日志过滤：在日志到达控制台和文件之前按规则拦截丢弃，减少刷屏、节省硬盘。
- 正则过滤（包含匹配）、完全匹配、Logger 名称、日志等级多维过滤
- 白名单排除，保护关键日志
- 重复日志去重缓存
- 配置热重载——改完存盘即生效，无需重启
- 双语配置注释，正则/TOML 转义的坑全部写在配置内
